connector.name: MCP ZAP Server
connector.registryDescription: Safe, self-hosted OWASP ZAP operator for guided AI security scans and reports.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image mcp-zap-server:v0.11.0. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the dtkmn account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ZAP_API_URL

env.name: MCP_API_KEY
env.description: API key clients must send as X-API-Key.

env.name: MCP_SERVER_TOOLS_SURFACE
env.description: Tool surface to expose. Use guided for the safer default workflow, including report readback. Use expert only when clients need raw ZAP tools outside the guided surface.
